I can do that — a couple quick clarifications before I forward the thread:

1. Recipient — please give the exact email or group alias to send to (e.g., finance@… or an internal group name). I won't send without a specific address.
2. Attachments — include all thread attachments, exclude attachments, or include only specific ones? (If you want only some, say which.)
3. Cover message — do you want to add a brief message? Suggested default:
   "Hi Finance team — forwarding the Q3 budget review thread for your review. Please advise next steps. Thanks, [Your Name]"
   Approve that or tell me what to write.
4. Send vs draft — should I send it now once details are confirmed, or create a draft for your review first?
5. Thread confirmation — I’ll look up the thread titled "Q3 budget review" and forward it. If there are multiple threads with that title I’ll ask which one to use.

Tell me your answers (or paste the group address and any message) and I’ll proceed.
